scenarios.criterion: Elara, signed in, MUST see her saved expedition drawn again after reopening the reagent map, and the shop MUST hold it with both ends within 1 km of where she placed them (spec AC11, rule R6).
scenarios.name: Signed-in adventurer sees a saved expedition again after reopening the reagent map
given: Elara has drawn a line on the reagent map from Moonwell Spring to Ember Crag and saved it
then: The saved expedition is drawn on the map
The shop holds the expedition with both ends within 1 km of where Elara placed them

scenarios.criterion: When no adventurer is signed in and a completed line is on the map, saving it MUST ask the adventurer to sign in and MUST NOT send a POST or store anything (spec AC12, rule R7).
scenarios.name: Saving without being signed in asks the adventurer to sign in and stores nothing
given: A completed line is drawn on the reagent map
when: The adventurer tries to save the line
then: The adventurer is asked to sign in
Nothing is sent to the shop
Nothing new is stored

scenarios.criterion: When both points of a completed line are less than 1 km apart, saving it MUST show the server's own zero-length message and MUST NOT store anything (spec AC13, rule R7).
scenarios.name: Saving a zero-length line shows the shop's own message and stores nothing
given: Both points of a completed line are less than 1 km apart
then: The shop's own zero-length message is shown to the adventurer
Nothing new is stored

scenarios.criterion: An unsaved line MUST NOT be shown, and nothing MUST be stored, after the adventurer leaves the reagent map and opens it again (spec AC15, rule R8).
scenarios.name: An unsaved line is gone after leaving and reopening the reagent map
given: An adventurer has placed one or two points on the reagent map
The adventurer has not saved the line
when: The adventurer leaves the reagent map and opens it again
then: No draft point or draft line remains on the map
Nothing new is stored

scenarios.criterion: Once this order ships, apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/.env MUST set VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true so the nav link and route show by default, and setting the variable to false MUST still hide both.
scenarios.name: The reagent map is visible by default
given: The shop is configured with its shipped default settings
then: The reagent map nav link is visible
The reagent map route is reachable

scenarios.criterion: Once this order ships, apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/.env MUST set VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP=true so the nav link and route show by default, and setting the variable to false MUST still hide both.
scenarios.name: Turning the reagent map feature flag off hides the map
given: The shop's reagent map feature flag is set to false
then: The reagent map nav link is hidden
The reagent map route is not reachable

scenarios.criterion: Every test that saves an expedition MUST restore apps/mock-api/data/expeditions.json afterward, and no test MUST see an expedition another test saved, proven by running the reagent map specs at --workers=3 --repeat-each=3 with reagent-map-expeditions.spec.ts still counting exactly Elara's expeditions. No existing count assertion MUST be loosened to make this pass.
scenarios.name: Concurrently saving expeditions keeps each adventurer's own data intact
given: Two adventurers are signed in on separate sessions
when: Both adventurers save a completed line at the same time
then: Each adventurer sees only their own newly saved expedition
Elara's expedition count is exactly what it was before, plus her own save, unaffected by the other adventurer's save

scenarios.criterion: Only a @visual baseline this order changes on purpose MUST be regenerated, in both runner images, via scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh --update-baselines and --ubi9 --update-baselines; every changed PNG MUST be viewed by eye and the delivery record MUST state what changed and why; no tolerance MUST be raised.
scenarios.name: The reagent map's appearance is unchanged by the save feature unless a reviewed change is recorded
given: The reagent map's existing visual baselines
then: Each baseline is either unchanged or its change was viewed by eye and recorded with what changed and why
No visual comparison tolerance was raised to make a baseline pass

scenarios.criterion: Every new or changed function MUST keep cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test proven able to fail, and no file outside scope.paths MUST change except this order's own delivery record under docs/features/reagent-map-save/.
scenarios.name: The delivery stays within its agreed scope and quality bars
given: The save feature implementation is complete
then: Every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
Every changed line is covered by a test proven able to fail
No file outside the agreed scope paths changed except this order's own delivery record
